objective: Support nested AND/OR condition groups in Automation IR, Rhai compilation, and NodeEditorPanel UI while preserving 100% backward-compatibility for flat condition lists.

acceptance.criterion: AutomationIrSchema.conditions parses recursive ConditionGroup (AND/OR) while maintaining exact backward compatibility for legacy flat Condition[] arrays.
compileToRhai recursively compiles nested condition groups into Rhai expressions with correct parenthesis grouping, matching Figma frame 03 spec.
ConditionGroupEditor renders recursive condition trees with AND/OR toggles, adding child conditions/groups, and FlowSummaryNode accurately counts leaf conditions.
acceptance.verification: Vitest component tests in ConditionGroupEditor.test.tsx, NodeEditorPanel.test.tsx, and FlowSummaryNode.test.tsx

acceptance.criterion: CI code quality gates pass cleanly (cargo test, cargo clippy -D warnings, tsc, eslint --max-warnings=0, vitest, npm build).
acceptance.verification: Frontend and backend test run logs and build output
